Costa Rica: volcanoes, canals & the Caribbean

Oct 21–31, 2026 · Kelvin & Lauren · self-drive loop in a rented 4WD · 11 days, 6 bases
Read the watch-outs first

How the food picks were made: Spanish-language sources and review consensus, checked at the dish level — every restaurant card names the exact plate to order. Breakfasts and lunches are cheap local sodas and fondas; famous names only where they'd earn it. Hours and closing days were checked against the actual weekday you'll be in town. No dish-level Reddit threads surfaced for these towns, so nothing here claims Reddit backing — where a dish couldn't be verified, the card says so.

Watch-outs

  • Poás Volcano (Mon Oct 26) can close the same morning for volcanic gas — recheck before you drive up.
  • Route 32 landslides: check road status the morning of Oct 26 and again Oct 30; the fallback detour is Route 10 via Turrialba (+1–1.5 hrs).
  • Tortuguero has no ATM — carry cash: boats ~$6–8 per person each way, secure parking at La Pavona ~$10–16/night, park entry paid in advance.
  • Tenorio entry is a fixed window: Fri Oct 23, 10:00–10:40 AM only — time the drive from La Fortuna to land inside it.

Restaurant research: Spanish-language press, local blogs and review consensus, gathered Oct 21, 2026; hours can shift in the rainy season — when a card flags conflicting listings, trust the flag, not either listing. Stays marked “suggested” were the plan as researched and are not booked; everything marked BOOKED is confirmed.

Flights: UA 2702 / UA 1096 out, UA 1099 / UA 2341 home. Rental: Adobe Rent a Car 4WD, SJO pickup Oct 21, 12:30 PM → return Oct 31.

📍 Distances are straight-line estimates from your current location.
